Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

FABRIC FOR TARGET BANNER, 

RADAR RESPONSIVE

1- Scope — Prescribes requirements for fabric used in the manufacture of radar responsive target banner 
towed behind aircraft for giving air to air and ground lo air firing practice in conjunction with radar 
devices, 

2. Manufacture — The fabric shall be manufactured from polyethylene monofilament and metalHzing 
elements consisting of duraluminium or silver coated copper filament. Metallizing element shall be 
introduced in the weave of the fabric to give 24 filaments per 10 cm in the weft and 1 6 per 10 cm in 
the warp. The polyethylene monofilament shall have a nominal diameter of 0*5 ± 0'05 mm and it shall 
be neither pigmented nor heat treated. Metallizing element made from duraluminium or silver coated 
copper filament shall be flattened to form a strip of 035 mm wide having a thickness of 0'02 mm. The 
weave of the fabric shall be leno. 

3. Requirements — See Table 1. 

4. Marking— Each piece of fabric shall be legibly marked with the following: 

a) Name of the material, 

b) Manufacturer's name, 

c) Length of the piece, and 

d) Year of manufacture. 

4.1 ISI Certification Marl^ing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New 
Delhi 110001. 

5. Packing — Each roll of fabric shall be tied with 3-ply jute twine ^nd suitably wrapped with an inner 
layer of kraft paper and an outer layer of polyethylene film of at least 40 micron thickness. Six such 
roils shall be placed one over the other and then wrapped with heavy ceecloth to form a bale. 



This standard is based on Defence Specification No. CIADE/15 Fabric fdr target banner radar 
responsive. 



Adopted 20 March 1973
